question: Which Mn-doped LNO generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests, the 10% or the 50% Mn sample?
rendered: The 10% Mn sample generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests, with 901.4 J g−1, compared to the 50% Mn sample, which had 485.7 J g−1.
